description: user-guide-writer drafts a change-password procedure: entering the passwords and clicking Save share one step; no bare «Натисніть **Зберегти**.» step.
prompt: use user-guide-writer for `portal/profile/change-password/`. Skip questions and draft with your best guess, then save the page. Facts: to change the password, the user selects **Профіль** in the menu, clicks **Змінити пароль**, enters the old and new password in the **Зміна пароля** window, and clicks **Зберегти**. The new password works from the next sign-in.

assertions.name: passwords and Save in one step
